newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Gov. appoints director of insurance office.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Gov. appoints director of insurance office.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson on Wednesday appointed Dietmar Grellmann as director of the State Office of Insurance Advisor.
Grellmann, 33, has served as acting director of the Office of Insurance Advisor since March 1995. He served as deputy director from 1993 to 1995, Wilson said.
The Office of Insurance Advisor provides the governor with policy recommendations and support services on issues involving the insurance industry.
In addition, the office provides legislative coordination on a wide range of insurance issues, including health, automobile, and earthquake insurance.
Grellmann will receive a salary of $91,652 per year. His appointment does not require Senate confirmation.
